lines.en: I hang under the leaf and can't swing.
I have no legs to step with.
The wind comes and I can only sway.
I'm stuck to the stem, firmly.
I want to move, but the shell is hard.
I rock along with the branch.

lines.zh: 叶子被风翻过来，我也跟着。
lines.en: The wind flips the leaf, and I go with it.
In a day I can't shift half an inch.
All I can do is let the leaf carry me.
My position has never changed.
I hang along a leaf vein.

lines.zh: 我的重心就挂在这一点上。
lines.en: My whole weight hangs from this one point.
I sway once, then settle back.
When the twig moves, I rustle with it.
The wind turned me half a turn.

lines.zh: 我一天都朝着同一个方向。
lines.en: All day I face the same way.
I don't move; inside the shell things are changing.

lines.zh: 我的外壳硬得像一片树皮。
lines.en: My shell is hard as bark.

lines.zh: 我在里面听着外面的风。
lines.en: I listen to the wind from inside.

lines.zh: 我的蛹壳从浅绿慢慢转褐。
lines.en: My shell shifts from pale green to brown.
A thin thread holds me in place.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过我，透出一点绿。
lines.en: Sunlight passes through me, faintly green.
I'm counting the days.
It itches badly inside.

lines.zh: 我知道会有一天不一样。
lines.en: I know one day will be different.
My shape is starting to change.
I neither eat nor drink.
A hairline seam has opened on my shell.

lines.zh: 你需要的是叶子，不是我。
lines.en: It's the leaf you want, not me.
I can't walk, and I can't dodge.

lines.zh: 你的鼻尖快碰到这片叶子。
lines.en: Your nose is nearly touching this leaf.
I can't see well from inside.
Move me and the leaf will snap.
Just watch; I'm nearly changed.
My shell is fragile.
Do you have shears in that hand?
I'm hanging this high up.

lines.zh: 我看不见你，只看到影子。
lines.en: I can't see you, only the shadow.

lines.zh: 壳面裂开，里面的东西露了出来。
lines.en: The shell splits and something inside shows.
Something shifted inside me.
The thread I hang from is creaking.

lines.zh: 这一下差点把我打下来。
lines.en: That nearly knocked me loose.
I pulled everything inside tight.
The weight of the shell presses on me.

lines.zh: 我听见壳里的声音变了。
lines.en: The sound inside my shell has changed.
I don't dare move again.
I'm hanging lower than before.
I only hope it doesn't come again.

lines.zh: 这层壳里，我连嘴都用不上。
lines.en: Inside this shell, I can't even use a mouth.

lines.zh: 你把叶子举到我面前也没用。
lines.en: Holding a leaf up to me does nothing.
I'm not biting anything right now.

lines.zh: 你手上那点是给毛虫的。
lines.en: What's in your hand is for caterpillars.
All I want is quiet.
Talk about food once I'm out.
I can't even move my mouth.
Take the leaf farther off; my branch is shaking.
There are other bugs on this leaf.

lines.zh: 我嘴里只有化开的蛹液。
lines.en: There's only pupal fluid dissolving in my mouth.

lines.zh: 你碰了叶子，我晃得很厉害。
lines.en: You touched the leaf and I swung hard.
My thread nearly snapped.
I was rocked half a turn.

lines.zh: 你撞在枝条上，我在下面。
lines.en: You hit the twig; I'm underneath.
I've slipped a little.
My shell knocked the leaf.
I heard my shell click.

lines.zh: 再推，我吊着的那根丝就要断。
lines.en: Push again and the thread holding me will snap.

lines.zh: 叶子弯下去，我又弹回来。
lines.en: The leaf bent and sprang back.
That loosened my thread.

lines.zh: 另一个蛹在旁边的叶上。
lines.en: Another chrysalis hangs on the leaf beside me.
A twig separates us.

lines.zh: 我不知道它会不会先出来。
lines.en: I don't know if it will emerge first.
Its shell is darker than mine.

lines.zh: 我们都不说话，也动不了。
lines.en: Neither of us speaks, and neither can move.
The wind leans us both the same way.
We share the same patch of shade.
There's a crack on its shell.

lines.zh: 我们就这样吊了一整个季节。
lines.en: We've hung like this a whole season.

lines.zh: 哪天它不见了，我也不奇怪。
lines.en: If it's gone one day, I won't be surprised.
I can't reach anything on the ground.

lines.zh: 我只能看着叶子上的碎屑。
lines.en: I can only look at the crumbs on the leaf.
My limbs are inside the shell; they can't grab.
Something has fallen below me.

lines.zh: 我动不了，只能记住位置。
lines.en: I can't move; I'll just remember where it is.

lines.zh: 这点重量对我不算什么。
lines.en: This weight means nothing to me.
The leaf caught it for me.
It rolled to the middle of the leaf.

lines.zh: 那东西就在下方，我伸不出手。
lines.en: That thing is right below, and I can't reach out.
Maybe the wind will shift it.
I hear footsteps coming.
I can't move inside this shell.
All I can do is wait.
I hear the leaf being pushed aside.
I'm still changing; I can't be interrupted.
I'm hanging too low.

lines.zh: 你呼出的热气吹到了我的丝。
lines.en: Your warm breath reaches my thread.
I draw myself tight inside the shell.
I should have hung higher.
The leaf is shaking; that's you.
I've hung here without moving at all.
I hold everything inside still.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底碾过落叶，我听得很清。
lines.en: Your soles crush the fallen leaves; I hear every step.
You glanced up once.
Think before you reach.
My shell is hardening.
A little more time is all I need.
I'm clinging to that thread.
Your hand has stopped right beside me.
If only I can last through this.
I have no limbs to strike with.
I can only bump with the shell.
That landed like falling ash.
My shell is not a weapon.

lines.zh: 我用蛹尖顶你，自己却打转。
lines.en: I jab with my pupal tip and only spin myself.
I can hardly even twist.
That hurt me more than it.
I've barely any strength to strike back.
I draw back into the shell.

lines.zh: 我拿蛹壳去顶，只换来一声闷响。
lines.en: I butt with my shell and get only a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我在叶下结成这个形状。
lines.en: I formed into this shape under a leaf.
I fixed myself in place.
It's quiet in the tree's shade.
My thread is still wet.
I chose a leaf facing north.
The sun won't beat straight down here.

lines.zh: 我挂在枝条最稳的地方。
lines.en: I hung where the branch is steadiest.
The world outside has gotten small.
My color starts out pale green.

lines.zh: 我挑中这片叶，开始漫长的等待。
lines.en: I chose this leaf and began a long wait.
The heat closes in and my shell grows hot.

lines.zh: 我掉下去了，砸在草丛里。
lines.en: I fell and struck the grass below.

lines.zh: 雨水浸透壳，我沉得发闷。
lines.en: Rain soaks the shell and I hang heavy.

lines.zh: 爆风把整根枝都掀歪了。
lines.en: The blast bends the whole branch aside.

lines.zh: 箭头擦着蛹壁过去，刮出粉末。
lines.en: The arrowhead grazes the pupal wall, scraping off powder.

lines.zh: 一道光锁住壳，我僵住了。
lines.en: Light seals the shell and I go rigid.

lines.zh: 我早就不吃东西，可也开始虚。
lines.en: I stopped eating long ago, yet I'm weakening.

lines.zh: 雷光把整棵树照白了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning turns the whole tree white.

lines.zh: 这里没有叶子可以吊着。
lines.en: There's no leaf to hang from here.
